metadata.title: Brady Russell catches pass in Week 3
metadata.description: Brady Russell caught his only target for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
metadata.analysis: Russell has seen minimal involvement in the Seattle offense to begin the season, finishing with two targets or less in each of the first three games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

metadata.title: Brady Russell - Nabs two catches in season opener
metadata.description: Russell caught both of his targets for 20 yards and notched one tackle on special teams during Wednesday's 13-10 win over the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: Russell was on the field for 17 of Seattle's 50 offensive snaps as well as for 20 special-teams snaps. The two receptions were the first two catches (and touches) of his NFL career. Russell played a career-high 58 regular-season offensive snaps over 17 games last year, and Wednesday's workload suggests he may continue to increase his involvement in 2026, though he's not likely to be a desirable fantasy option given his role.

metadata.title: Brady Russell - Staying in Seattle
metadata.description: Russell is slated to re-sign with the Seahawks on a two-year deal, Tom Pelissero of NFL Network reports.
metadata.analysis: The 27-year-old from Colorado is now in line to remain in Seattle after spending the first three seasons of his NFL career with the team. Russell was a key special-teamer during the Seahawks' 2025 campaign, recording 14 total tackles and one fumble recovery across 454 total snaps (396 on special teams, 58 on offense). He's expected to operate in a similar role ahead of the 2026 season.

metadata.title: Brady Russell re-signs with Seahawks
metadata.description: The Seahawks re-signed FB Brady Russell to a two-year contract.
metadata.analysis: Russell will remain in a blocking and special teams role for Seattle.

metadata.title: Brady Russell - Played through hand injury
metadata.description: Russell underwent hand surgery the day after Seattle's 31-27 NFC Championship win over the Rams, Brady Henderson of ESPN reports.
metadata.analysis: Russell managed to play through his injury during the Seahawks' Super Bowl win over the Patriots, where he led the team in special-teams snaps. The 27-year-old will now have the offseason to get back to full health before the start of the 2027 campaign.

metadata.title: Brady Russell (hand) off injury report for Super Bowl
metadata.description: Brady Russell is off the injury report for the Super Bowl against the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: Russell closed the week with a full practice on Friday. He is officially a full-go heading into the big game on Sunday.

metadata.title: Brady Russell (hand) logs full practice Thursday
metadata.description: Brady Russell was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Russell was one of many full participants for Seattle with one day of practice left before the Super Bowl. He should be good to go on Sunday.

metadata.title: Brady Russell (hand) logs full practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Brady Russell was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Russell was listed as questionable on the injury report last week. He remains on track to be good to go in the Super Bowl on Sunday.

metadata.title: Brady Russell - Full go in practice
metadata.description: Russell (hand) was a full participant in Seattle's practice Wednesday, per Michael-Shawn Dugar of The Athletic.
metadata.analysis: Russell was a limited participant in practice throughout last week after suffering a hand injury during the NFC Championship Game but is seemingly healthy again. With Robbie Ouzts still battling a neck injury, Russell could be in line to serve as the team's top fullback in the Super Bowl on Sunday.

metadata.title: Brady Russell (hand) listed as questionable for Super Bowl
metadata.description: Brady Russell is listed as questionable for the Super Bowl next Sunday against the Patriots.
metadata.analysis: Russell was limited in practice all week. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff next Sunday.

metadata.title: Brady Russell (hand) limited in practice Thursday
metadata.description: Brady Russell remained limited in practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Russell has logged back-to-back limited practices to begin the week. He remains on track to be good to to into next week for the Super Bowl.
